'''February 2000 Tucson tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Kards 4 You, Tucson, Arizona on 26 February 2000. [[Michael Girard]] won it. It is known from Michael Girard's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d290">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-29-2-26-00-tuscond290/ 2-26-00-tuscon], DeckTech (Michael "Dvader" Girard, 29 February 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-29-2-26-00-tuscond290/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 26 February 2000
* '''Site:''' Kards 4 You, Tucson, Arizona
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Girard]]
